[EN] If there's anything I've learned from my posting here, it's that I need to work on my sycophantic skills.

My idiot cousin got assigned to Cutthroat Harbor, but I end up here. He takes his leave in Castanica. I take my leave in the ice. It's not fair.
[ES] Si algo he aprendido de mi destino aquí, es que necesito mejorar mis habilidades aduladoras.

A mi primo idiota lo asignaron a Cutthroat Harbor, pero yo termino aquí. Él toma sus vacaciones en Castanica. Yo tomo mis vacaciones en el hielo. No es justo.
